item.title: A year into new ownership, violence still plagues Ohio’s largest youth treatment center
item.description: The state tried to shut down the Mohican Young Star Academy youth treatment center over frequent 911 calls, runaways and use of restraints.

item.title: Democratic ex-congressman Tim Ryan won't run for Ohio governor, ending primary possibility
item.description: After months of considering whether he'd throw his hat in the ring, former U.S. Rep. Tim Ryan said he will not be joining the race.

item.title: It’s a bird! It’s a plane! It’s a free-fall parachute? The lifesaving device has Ohio roots
item.description: At the Aviation Trail Parachute Museum in Dayton, a timeline wraps around the room, detailing the invention of the life-saving contraption.

item.title: Ohio lawmakers ok a catch-all budget correction bill, though not without complaints
item.description: Ohio lawmakers from both parties in both chambers complained about how quickly the budget correction bill was put together.

item.title: Ohio House Republicans approve a ban on prescribing abortion drugs via telehealth
item.description: The latest Ohio Abortion Report shows there were 10,155 abortions involving abortion drugs in the state in 2024.

item.title: Why Ohio scientists - and some dairy producers - are against legalizing raw milk
item.description: The sale of raw milk has been banned in Ohio since 1997, with some exceptions. But some lawmakers want to change that.

item.title: A forecast shows shoppers will bring the festive holiday season to Ohio's retailers
item.description: Consumer sentiment is at a 10 year low. But Ohio’s retailers are still expecting a good holiday season this year.

item.title: The OUtlet - November 21, 2025 - WOUB Public Media
item.description: ATHENS, Ohio (WOUB) — This week on The OUtlet, a new mascot helps the community learn to recycle, and a kitchen fire temporarily shuts down Jackie O’s Public House.
